body:
Fix a missing zero in the `reg` property of the `backup` partition. 

It seems the offset must be 0xfe0000 instead of 0xfe000, which is most likely just a typo, similar to the one fixed in PR #23511

reviews.body:
Reviewed 1 new commit; no new issues found.

The fix is correct: in both DTS files the `backup` partition node is named `partition@fe0000` and sits between `debug` (`0xfd0000`) and `bdinfo` (`0xff0000`), each 0x10000 in size, so the unit address 0xfe0000 is the intended offset. The old `reg = <0xfe000 ...>` was missing a digit, pointing at 0x0fe000 (inside the `firmware` partition) and mismatching the node name. The change aligns `reg` with the node address and the surrounding layout, consistent with the precedent in #23511.
